name: decimal-input
source:
Print Val("0.1")
Print Val("3.141")
Print Val("16777217.0")
Print Val("-2147483648")
Print Val("$80000000")
Print Val("1000000e-20")
Print Val("1e")/2
Print Val("1e+")/2
Print Val("1e65536")

encoding.notes: Explicit big-endian opcodes and payloads: Print=0x0476, Val=0x05a4, parentheses=0x0074/0x007c, string=0x0026 with byte length and even padding, divide=0xffec, integer=0x003e. No production token table/encoder was used.

evidence.notes: ValRout classifies a decimal point or exponent sign/digits as float; bare 1e remains an integer. declong checks the positive magnitude before applying a sign, so decimal -2147483648 returns zero while hex $80000000 remains valid. a2ffp builds mantissa digits via private FFP multiply/add, applies repeated FFP decimal scaling, and uses a signed 16-bit exponent. The scale for 1000000e-20 underflows before its final multiplication. Expected values are source interpretations, not captured AMOS execution.
